subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, given the new authenticated audio RPC and microphone privacy boundary?
rationale: The implementation direction is plausible and better aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but adding a core browser-to-Gateway audio transcription method is a product and privacy boundary decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Continue Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
options.body: Require the current branch or replacement to port onto the refactored chat composer, fix accessibility/docs-map issues, and supply successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the paired feature issue
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open but do not land until maintainers explicitly settle the Control UI dictation boundary and ownership.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: If maintainers do not want core dictation now or prefer a fresh implementation, close this PR and route future work through the paired issue or a new narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Continue Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
recommendation.body: Require the current branch or replacement to port onto the refactored chat composer, fix accessibility/docs-map issues, and supply successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.
